column2: qa-suite (supplemental, INS family): a pair — eGFR "30" makes the calculation cite the eGFR clause; eGFR ">90" makes it absent. The pair is the point: the absence assertion has been seen to fail.
Unit (AdjustInsulinInfusionRateRuleTest): boundary — eGFR 45 produces no clause, 44.9 produces the clause.

[BLOCKED - live defect, needs a bug ticket and a fix first] Importer test: importing a header-only file into a tenant that already holds pathways must throw rather than delete, asserting the repository still holds the previous rows. Fails today - the tenant is silently emptied - so this cannot be written as a passing regression test until the delete-without-replacement is fixed.

[BLOCKED - separate live defect found during this run, needs its own bug ticket and a fix first] Regression test: concurrent SIU^S14 messages for one (patient, case) must not abort on the operations unique constraint uk9dj8ufodtosa5mfnq085yr1sh. Not coverage for OR-2774 - the race is unfixed, so this cannot be written green today.

MGBGetQTCIntervalR4Command: characterization test pinning what the quantity-only filter currently does with a Range-, Ratio- and String-valued QTc, and that the refusal is logged. Widening QTc to the shared extraction is a product decision, not part of this test.

MockMvc (standaloneSetup or @WebMvcTest) class covering both cases: GET /api/admin/observations/patient/{unknown}/ responds 404 with message 'Patient not found' (the @ResponseStatus mapping the unit test never exercises), and GET for an existing patient responds 200 with the observation list as the control.

ProcedureBasedWrongAntibioticRuleTest case driven by the shipped Mayo p-pancreatectomy + p-biliary-stent-placement resolution (not mocked candidates): cefazolin fires the alert naming Piperacillin-Tazobactam, pip-tazo abstains. Sibling of OR-2776#2 (whipple pair); write them together.

qa-suite supplemental LAMD-002 in clinical-rules/local-anesthetic.spec.ts (LAMD-001 already exists): stage a patient whose dosing weight puts a local anesthetic ceiling over 1000 mg, POST the medication selection, assert the response contains w-last-local-anesthetic-max-dose with a prompt quoting the remaining dose. Regression guard at the API boundary, where the pre-fix build returned 200 with the rule silently missing.

INS-010 (@supplemental, insulin-glucose.spec.ts; INS-008/009 are taken by OR-2743): insulin administration posted on a case whose end_time is already set arms no post-insulin-glucose-check job. Assert via GET /api/admin/quartz/jobs that no job exists for the case, with a same-shape open-case control in the same test so the absence assertion is provably able to fail.

INS-011 (@supplemental, insulin-glucose.spec.ts): a post-insulin-glucose-check reminder armed on an open case survives a procedure-finish event and is cancelled only by case close. Assert via /api/admin/quartz/jobs that the job is present after PROCEDURE_END and gone after CLOSE_APP.

[BLOCKED - live defect with no bug ticket filed as of 2026-09-25] Regression test: concurrent SIU^S14 messages for one (patient, case) must not abort on the operations unique constraint uk9dj8ufodtosa5mfnq085yr1sh. The processor retry (concurrentInsert_retriesAsUpdate, June 2026) predates the race and did not prevent it in the OR-2774 run, so the fix is elsewhere. Not coverage for OR-2774; file the bug, then write this on it.

orci-repositories @DataJpaTest: updatePrimaryPractitionerIfNotSet must not touch a row whose primary_practitioner_id is already set (assert last_modified_date unchanged too, not just the practitioner), and neither statement may match a same-caseId row belonging to a different patient. Runs in CI, unlike the *IntegrationTest classes that pin this today.

qa-suite @supplemental PRAC-006/PRAC-007 in integrations/mayo/hl7-practitioner-attribution.spec.ts (PRAC-001..005 already cover case-start attribution): inject In Room then Anes Start through the HL7 admin send endpoint and assert the case primary practitioner is the Anes Start sender via the API; then the reverse order as the negative, asserting the In Room sender does not displace the Anes Start attribution.

[BLOCKED on OR-2720 - fails today on demo/mgb 5640 -> famotidine/gabapentin/omeprazole and 7258 -> esomeprazole] Backend data-integrity test over each org master-rxnorm-list.csv: every RxNorm code listed in allergy-cross-reaction-groups.csv for the NSAID group must map only to medications carrying the NSAID category. Write it alongside the OR-2720 mapping fix.

Extend EventServiceCaseStopComplianceIntegrationTest: CLOSE_APP -> evaluateComplianceForCaseOnStop for a firing with EVALUATION_DATE inside the case and created_date after the operation end, patient carrying an infusion; assert a compliance_results row is written and no IllegalArgumentException is logged. This is the shape the Sentry crash took; every unit test mocks away one of the three ingredients.

Same EventServiceCaseStopComplianceIntegrationTest fixture with EVALUATION_DATE moved past the operation end: assert compliant=true and the is-not-intraoperative warning, locking the out-of-scope branch at the wiring level.

[BLOCKED - live defect on main as of 2026-09-25, no bug ticket filed] Importer test: a header-only antibiotic-pathways.csv (valid header, zero data rows) into a tenant that already holds pathways must throw rather than delete. refusesToReplaceAPopulatedTenantWithNothing covers a file whose rows resolve to nothing, but both importer guards require at least one read row, so the literally-empty file still empties the tenant. File the bug, then write this on it.

Pin the rule-5 shape per shipped file: for mayo, demo and mgb antibiotic-pathways.csv assert the exact set of procedures that carry a pathway with no allergy fallback beside a sibling that has one (today listed only as prose in ANTIBIOTIC_RESOLUTION_TEST_CASES.md). A config edit that adds or removes a silenced procedure then fails a test instead of silently changing guidance.

Pin the shipped p-pancreatectomy pair in AntibioticPathwayCSVImporterTest next to bundledMayoFileEncodesTheOR2792Pathways (runs in CI; MayoProcedureConfigImportIntegrationTest does not): exactly two pathways, risks {LOW, HIGH}, notations CEFAZOLIN AND METRONIDAZOLE -> LEVOFLOXACIN AND METRONIDAZOLE and CEFTRIAXONE AND METRONIDAZOLE -> LEVOFLOXACIN AND METRONIDAZOLE.

SUG-005 (@supplemental, sugammadex.spec.ts; SUG-003/004 are claimed by OR-2886): 36.9 kg adult with prior vecuronium and TOF 2 selecting sugammadex returns dose options 75/150/600 mg, the 75 mg option flagged default, each annotated rounded to the nearest 25 mg; the same response contains no 73.8/147.6/590.4 mg option, so unrounded and rounded doses are never offered side by side.
SUG-006 (@supplemental, sugammadex.spec.ts): 45 kg adult in the same scenario keeps the configured 50 mg step (100/200/700 mg), guarding the 40 kg threshold from regressing.

Extend EventServiceCaseStopComplianceIntegrationTest: a CLOSE_APP category event on a case carrying a SILENT glucose-alert firing plus a glucose inside the ten-minute buffer flips the fire-time non-compliant row to compliant, covering the EventService afterCommit to evaluateComplianceForCaseOnStop wiring. Shares the fixture with OR-2796#0/#1.
